verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents various payment APIs (agent checkouts, x402, MPP) but there is no evidence of a versioned commerce protocol spec, published schema, or conformance/validation tooling — an explicit probe for OpenAPI/swagger schemas returned 404 on all candidate paths, and the docs describe agent checkouts as v1 without even a staging environment, suggesting immaturity rather than a stable spec with conformance tooling.
